subject: Newsletter text as a text source
body:
Your site describes turning enterprise documents and email into schema-mapped, timestamped datasets for training and retrieval. Public newsletter issues are long-form business text with named companies in them, which is the same shape of input, sourced from outside a customer's own estate.

NewsletterFIT holds more than 27,000 publications and 143,000 articles, with entity, topic and sponsor extraction, each record with URL and date. If a customer-facing dataset of that kind is useful, I can send a sample. If your roadmap is entirely customer-tenant data, a one-line no is fine and I will not follow up.
